in_hebrew.name: Blunt
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Direct, honest, unyielding
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Blunt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Blunt derives from Old English word 'bluntan', meaning 'to crush, to bruise'. The name has been used to describe someone who is straightforward and honest, someone who is unyielding and direct. It's a name for those who value honesty and directness above all else.
